description: Service bindings: connect an IBM Cloud service instance (through its service_access secret) to a Code Engine app or job. Identify a binding with project_id and binding_id. Call get_schema with name ce_binding for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List bindings. | get: Get one binding. Needs binding_id. | create: Bind secret_name to a component (component_resource_type app_v2 or job_v2). Needs component_name, component_resource_type, secret_name. | delete: Delete a binding. Needs binding_id.

binding_id.description: Binding id, from ce_binding action list.

component_name.description: Name of the CE app or job to bind the service to

prefix.description: Prefix for environment variable names injected into the component (optional)

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

secret_name.description: Name of the operator secret referencing the IBM Cloud service instance

name: ce_binding
